scope: Local book reading, deterministic checks against a copy of current production sources, and read-only historical CSV recomputation. No new runtime or pressure workload; no Git mutation.
head: cc2d381 (working tree includes dynamic inventory implementation)

counterexample_check.kind: Reachable-state checks using production pool/scheduler/inventory methods; replacement completion is supplied by the fixture; logical time, not a measured workload.

cases.name: queue_waiting_for_execution_slot
cases.interpretation: An execution-slot queue triggers inventory expansion despite available READY instances.

cases.name: sparse_requests_without_inventory_wait
cases.interpretation: Remembered consumption signals raise inventory even when replacement has completed and no request queues. Recurring activity prevents the full idle timeout.

historical_benchmark.kind: Historical cold vs fixed warm, not current dynamic vs fixed comparison
historical_benchmark.p50_method: nearest rank over successful HTTP 200 requests with confirmed cleanup, using rounded CSV milliseconds
